in_marathi.name: Ashrita
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Protected by God
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ashrita हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Ashrita is a Sanskrit name derived from the root 'ashr' meaning 'to reside'. The suffix 'ita' denotes 'that which is'. The name suggests a woman who is protected by the divine. It is a name that instills a sense of security and strength in the bearer.
